draft-control.text: Can you help me draft a control for SOX compliance around user access reviews?

Sure! Here's a draft control for periodic user access reviews:

**Control: Quarterly User Access Review**

All privileged and sensitive system access must be reviewed quarterly by the responsible system owner. Accounts that are no longer needed must be revoked within 5 business days of review completion.

This aligns with SOX ITGC requirements for logical access management.

draft-control.title: Quarterly User Access Review
draft-control.description: All privileged and sensitive system access must be reviewed quarterly by the responsible system owner.

summarize-audit.text: Querying audits closed in the last 90 days…

Your last quarter closed **14 findings across 7 controls**. Three themes dominate: access provisioning lag (5 findings), two-approver gaps in production change management (4), and overdue vendor risk reviews (3). The remaining 2 are one-off documentation gaps.

risk-description.text: Help me write a risk description
Happy to. A strong risk description names the threat, the asset, and the business impact. Three quick questions first:

risk-description.intro: A few details about the risk:
risk-description.summaryText: Got it. Drafting your risk description with these answers.

steps.question: Which area does this risk live in?
What's the nature of the threat?
Name the system or process at stake.
steps.placeholder: e.g., Production AWS accounts, quarterly close process…

followUp.text: Here's a draft based on your answers:

followUp.title: Unauthorized access to production systems
followUp.description: There is a risk that terminated or transferred employees retain active access to production systems, allowing unauthorized changes or data exposure that could result in financial misstatement and regulatory penalties.

triage-issues.text: Pulling open issues from the Issues module…
You have **9 open issues**. Two are Critical and both relate to terminated-user access, so I'd start there. Severity-ranked:

rows.title: Terminated users retain active IAM access
Root account MFA disabled in legacy AWS org
Stale firewall rules on finance subnet
Quarterly access review 1 week behind schedule
Backup restore test not documented for Q1
Shared service account in reporting pipeline
Policy doc references retired ticketing system

triage-issues.intro: How do you want to act on these?

quarterly-access-review.text: What percentage of active audits are past their end date and not complete, and can we send them an email reminder?

description.intro: Got it. Two parts: a metric (how much of the active audit load is overdue and incomplete) and an action (nudge the owners). Here's how I'd tackle it:

bullets.label: Fetch all active audits
bullets.detail: Pull every audit currently marked active so we have the full set to measure against.

bullets.label: Filter for past end date
bullets.detail: Keep only the audits whose end date has already passed.

bullets.label: Filter for not complete
bullets.detail: Of those, keep the ones whose completion checklist is still open.

bullets.label: Calculate the percentage
bullets.detail: Overdue-and-incomplete count over the active total, so you have the number for reporting.

bullets.label: Compile the overdue list
bullets.detail: Name, owner, end date, and percent complete for each audit that needs a nudge.

bullets.label: Send reminder emails
bullets.detail: I'll draft one reminder per owner and show you the email in a modal so you can confirm before anything goes out.

description.outro: Look right? Hit **Run plan** to kick it off, or **Revise** if you want me to rework the approach first.

quarterly-access-follow-up.text: Find users in our HR system marked inactive who still have active access in IAM, and open a remediation issue.

description.intro: Got it. Sounds like a quarterly access review across HR and IAM, ending with a remediation issue. Here's how I'd tackle it:

bullets.label: Import IAM access table
bullets.detail: Pull the current 1,284-user access table out of IAM.

bullets.label: Import HR roster
bullets.detail: Pull the matching HR roster (about 1,302 employees).

bullets.label: Join on email address
bullets.detail: Match users across both systems by email so we have one row per person.

bullets.label: Filter for HR-inactive / IAM-active
bullets.detail: Surface anyone marked inactive in HR but still active in IAM. These are the access-still-live offboarding gaps.

bullets.label: Open remediation issue
bullets.detail: I'll show you a draft issue (title, severity, owner, deprovision deadline) so you can review before I file it.

description.outro: Look right? Hit **Run plan** to kick it off, or **Revise** to tweak the approach.

abilities.name: Floating Panel
abilities.description: Detached, draggable chat overlay that floats above content.

abilities.name: Clear Assistant
abilities.description: Resets the conversation and returns to the empty state.

abilities.name: Side Car Right
abilities.description: Docks the chat into a column on the right edge of the workspace.

abilities.name: Side Car Left
abilities.description: Docks the chat into a column on the left edge of the workspace.

abilities.name: Confirm Tool
abilities.description: Asks for explicit Allow / Deny before the assistant performs a tool action.

abilities.name: Entity Card Suggestion
abilities.description: Structured preview of a draft entity (Issue, Control, Risk) the assistant suggests creating, with a primary "Create" action.

abilities.name: Entity Reference
abilities.description: Pill in the input area representing an attached entity. Can be pinned or removed.

abilities.name: Context Entity Picker
abilities.description: Floating menu for picking an entity type to attach. Triggered by `@` or the at-button.

abilities.name: External Sources
abilities.description: Lists web or internal sources cited alongside the assistant's response.

abilities.name: Message Action Bar
abilities.description: Per-message row of copy, like, and dislike actions on assistant replies.

abilities.name: Message Queue
abilities.description: Holds follow-up questions submitted while the assistant is still working on a complex one.

abilities.name: Arrival State
abilities.description: Empty-state landing view shown on arrival, with starter prompts contextual to the current Optro module.

abilities.name: Show Error State
abilities.description: Surfaces tool/connector failures inline with a red Notice.

abilities.name: Attach Files
abilities.description: Opens the OS file picker and attaches selected files as Entity Reference chips above the input.

abilities.name: Plan Mode
abilities.description: The assistant drafts a plan, runs through its steps for you, and pauses at the end for a quick review before any write goes out. Click again to cycle through demos. Dev tip: type any question with the Plan checkbox OFF to see the same work run as streamed thinking with no plan card.

abilities.name: Follow-Up Wizard
abilities.description: Asks clarifying questions one at a time before producing a final answer. Useful when the request is ambiguous.

abilities.name: Draft a Control
abilities.description: Drafts a SOX-aligned control with description and produces an entity card.

abilities.name: Create an Issue
abilities.description: Generates a tracked Issue from a finding and lets you create it inline.

abilities.name: Inline Citations
abilities.description: Cite sources inline within the body text as small numbered chips that link out to each reference.

abilities.name: Suggestion Buttons
abilities.description: Follow-up prompt chips that appear under a response to suggest the next step.

abilities.name: Saved Prompts
abilities.description: Trigger a "/" typeahead to insert from a library of saved prompts. Also holds saved Plans; picking one stages a reviewable plan preview.

abilities.name: Diff View
abilities.description: Show a side-by-side or inline diff when the assistant suggests edits.

abilities.name: Collapsible Message
abilities.description: Show more / show less toggle for very long responses.

abilities.name: File Drop Zone
abilities.description: Drag-and-drop files anywhere on the panel to attach them.

abilities.name: Data Table
abilities.description: Inline markdown-style data table with a semantic <table>, header and footer (with metadata), datetime formatting, status/badge cell types, horizontal scroll for wide tables, and progressive row streaming. a11y: scope=col, captions, focusable scroll region.

abilities.name: Entity Card Reference
abilities.description: Pulls up one or more existing entities for review, each with an "Add to Context" action.

abilities.name: Abort Process
abilities.description: Stop button in the input area that halts an in-flight streaming response.

abilities.name: Persona Switcher
abilities.description: Switch the assistant's persona (Field Agent or Evidence Collector) to scope its context to a specific role. The persona pins as context for the rest of the session.

abilities.name: Chart Output
abilities.description: Renders charts inline in the chat from data in the user's Optro model: pie for distributions, bar for rankings, line for trends. Each chart has a Download-as-PNG action.

abilities.name: Knowledge Base for Agents
abilities.description: Each agent persona has a private file repository (uploaded in Settings → AI → Agent Settings). When that agent is active, the assistant grounds its responses in those files and surfaces a source citation for each answer.

abilities.name: Plan Mode: Supervised
abilities.description: Same plan flow, but you can flag any step for review before it runs, edit or skip steps, and save the plan as a template. Saved plans can be re-run from the Saved Prompts picker.

knowledgeBase.question: How does management's ICFR assessment process work, and what must be documented to support it?
knowledgeBase.answerMarkdown: **Management's ICFR assessment process** involves obtaining a sufficient understanding of each component of internal control, identifying potential misstatements, assessing risk factors, and designing appropriate procedures. The process should follow a top-down, risk-based approach: identify significant accounts and disclosures, understand the flow of transactions, assess entity-level and process-level controls, evaluate design and operating effectiveness, and document conclusions.
